 What to Stream 15 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Oct 26-Nov 1): Summer Vacation, Dead-End Job, To The Perfect Lie on Netflix, Viki, JioHotstar 
 We round up 15 K-drama OTT releases to watch this week, October 26-November 1, starting with Summer Vacation, Dead-End Job and The Perfect Lie, followed by Final Table, Doctor X: Mafia in White, 100 Days of Deception and more. From romance and psychological suspense to supernatural horror, historical intrigue and culinary competitions, these Korean dramas offer a varied watchlist across Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar and Viki. The K-drama OTT releases this week, October 26-November 1, include Summer Vacation, Dead-End Job, The Perfect Lie, Final Table, Doctor X: Mafia in White, 100 Days of Deception and more.  Late October brings a varied lineup of K-drama OTT releases this week, October 26-November 1. New titles include the sun-warmed romance Summer Vacation, starring Jin Young and Cho Yi-hyun, followed by the darker Dead-End Job, led by Lee Jae-wook and Go Min-si, and the psychological thriller The Perfect Lie, featuring Yoo Yeon-seok and Seo Hyun-jin. Returning dramas round out the week with new episodes of Final Table, Doctor X: Mafia in White, 100 Days of Deception, Love in Disguise, Between Steps, Merry Berry Love, kiDnap GAME, Oh! My Guard, Make Me Tingle, Love on the Menu, A Love Other Than Yours and Dive into You. Check out the 15 new K-drama OTT releases this week, with release dates and cast, below.
 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Oct 26-Nov 1)
 Summer Vacation (Viki): Oct 26
 Cho Yi-hyun plays Kim Ha-yeon, an 18-year-old whose summer in Upo Village shifts when she meets Jo Yu-gyeom (Jin Young), the landowner’s son. Romance and mystery share the season.
 Dead-End Job (Netflix): Oct 30
 Lee Jae-wook plays Hyeok-jun, who takes a part-time job paying fifty times the usual wage. The catch is a workplace full of horrors. All episodes drop together, with Go Min-si in the cast.
 The Perfect Lie (JioHotstar): Oct 30
 A cardiac surgeon (Yoo Yeon-seok) and a school librarian (Seo Hyun-jin) remember the same event in conflicting ways. This psychological thriller asks which of them is telling the truth.
 Final Table (Prime Video): Oct 31 and Nov 1
 Ahn Hyo-seop returns as head chef Kang Han, who enters a national cooking contest to represent his restaurant. Episodes 3 and 4 arrive this weekend.
 Doctor X: Mafia in White (Netflix): Oct30 and 31
 Kim Ji-won plays a fearless surgeon who takes on a corrupt university hospital. It is a Korean take on the Japanese hit. Episodes 7 and 8 stream.
 100 Days of Deception (Netflix): Oct 31 and Nov 1
 Set in 1932 Gyeongseong, this spy romance pairs a pickpocket-turned-agent (Kim Yoo-jung) with an interpreter (Park Jin-young). Episodes 7 and 8 land this weekend.

 Yim Si-wan plays a chaebol heir suspected of murder. Seol In-ah is the detective who goes undercover as his male secretary to watch him. Episodes 3 and 4.
 Between Steps (JioHotstar): Oct 26 and 27
 In a robotics lab, a former swimmer (Choo Young-woo) and a graduate student (Kim So-hyun) both rethink their futures. Episodes 7 and 8 continue their slow, tender romance.
 Merry Berry Love (JioHotstar): Oct 27
 A designer in crisis (Ji Chang-wook) retreats to a Japanese island and meets a strawberry farmer (Imada Mio). Episode 4 of this cross-border romance arrives.
 kiDnap GAME (JioHotstar): Oct 27
 A kidnapping unfolds across seven cities at once, with Sakaguchi Kentaro and Lee Joon-gi among the players. Episode 4 raises the stakes.
 Oh! My Guard (Viu): Octo 31 and Nov 1
 Jung Yong-hwa plays a famous actor whose life tangles with a mysterious woman (Hong Seung-hee). Episodes 3 and 4 bring misunderstandings and romance.
 Make Me Tingle (Viki): Oct 29
 A conservative marketer (Nam Ji-hyun) and a cynical start-up CEO (Kim Jae-yeong) challenge each other’s ideas about intimacy. Episodes 7 and 8 stream Thursday.
 A Love Other Than Yours (Prime Video): Oct 31 and Nov 1
 A couple of ten years wonders whether love or habit keeps them together. Episodes 13 and 14 arrive this weekend.
 Dive into You (Viki): Oct 31 and Nov 1
 An actress swaps souls with her judo-champion twin and travels back in time to save her first love. Bona leads. Episodes 11 and 12.
 Love on the Menu (Viki): Oct 31 and Nov 1
 Ha Seok-jin and Hani play exes who reunite eight years after a painful split. Episodes 26 and 27 rebuild their broken families.
